value.title: Cisco VPN : LDAP Connections are failing
value.description: Converted from Splunk alert on networksyslog cisco:asa 'Windows_LDAP as FAILED' > 3 per minute

input.value: fetch logs | filter dt.system.bucket == "networksyslog" | filter contains(content, "Windows_LDAP as FAILED") | makeTimeseries count = count(default: 0), interval:1m

properties.value: Cisco VPN : LDAP Connections are failing which will impact end users using windows basic
More than 3 'Windows_LDAP as FAILED' messages in 1 minute from Cisco ASA (networksyslog). VPN users with Windows credentials cannot log in.
